spans.s: प्र-√ खन् (only aor. -खान्), to dig up, uproot, eradicate, Kathās.
very hard or rough, Prasannar.
very hot or acrid, Bhām.
iron armour for the defence of a horse or elephant, L. (cf. प्रक्खर, प्र-क्षर)
a mule, L.
a dog, L.
a great scoundrel or villain, Mṛcch.
प्र-√ खाद् P. -खादति, to eat up, devour, RV.
प्र-˚खाद॑ mfn. swallowing, devouring, ib.
प्र-√ खिद् (only pr. p. -खिद॑त्), to thrust away, VS.
प्र-√ खुद् P. -खुद॑ति, futuere, AV.; ŚāṅkhGṛ.
प्र-˚ख्या (आ), f. look, appearance (only ifc. = resembling, like), MBh.; R. &c.
brightness, splendour (only ifc.), R.
perceptibility, visibility, Jaim.
making manifest, disclosure, Daśar.
प्र-˚ख्य॑ mfn. visible, clear, bright, ŚBr.; MBh.
प्र-˚ख्यस् m. = प्रजा-पति, Uṇ. iv, 232, Sch.
the planet Jupiter, L.
प्र-˚ख्यात mfn. known, celebrated, acknowledged, recognised, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
forestalled, claimed by right of pre-emption, Mn. (see below)
pleased, happy, W.
‘told (by others)’, i.e. borrowed, not original, Daśar.
प्र-˚ख्यात—बल-वीर्य mfn. of celebrated strength and valour, R.
प्र-˚ख्यात—भाण्ड n. (with राज्ञः) a commodity the pre-emption of which is claimed by a king, Mn. viii, 399
प्र-˚ख्यात—वप्तृक mfn. having a celebrated father, L.
प्र-˚ख्यात—सद्-भर्तृ m. known as a good husband, Kathās.
प्र-˚ख्याति f. visibility, perceptibility, celebrity (only अ-प्रख्˚), MBh.
praise, eulogium, W.
प्र-˚ख्यान n. the being perceived or known, Pāṇ. i, 2, 54
= ˚ख्यापन, R.
प्र-˚ख्यानीय mfn. to be celebrated or made known, Vop.
प्र-˚ख्यापन n. making known, report, information, R.; Daś.
प्र-˚ख्यापनीय mfn. to be made known or published, Vop.
प्र-˚ख्यापित mfn. known as, named (with nom.), Caṇḍ.
प्र-˚ख्यायमान mfn. being celebrated or spoken about, Nal.
प्रा—खर्य n. (fr. -खर) sharpness (of an arrow), Naiṣ., Sch.
wickedness, W.
